content.text: {"errors":[],"loaded":["pcb_export","project"],"tools":[{"description":"Export Gerber production files using kicad-cli. By default Konnect selects all enabled copper layers, masks, silkscreens, and Edge.Cuts while excluding documentation-only layers.","name":"export_gerber"},{"description":"Export the PCB layout to a PDF file using kicad-cli.","name":"export_pdf"},{"description":"Export the PCB layout to an SVG file using kicad-cli.","name":"export_svg"},{"description":"Export the PCB as a 3D model (STEP or VRML) using kicad-cli.","name":"export_3d"},{"description":"Generate a Bill of Materials (BOM) CSV from the schematic's component data.","name":"export_bom"},{"description":"Export the PCB netlist to a file in KiCAD or IPC-D-356 format.","name":"export_netlist"},{"description":"Export a deterministic Specctra DSN routing job from the exact live KiCad PCB editor revision. Requires the named board to be open with IPC enabled. On KiCad 10, an enabled authenticated ActionPlugin bridge supplies KiCad's native DSN while the IPC snapshot and reverse manifest remain authoritative; otherwise the Rust exporter is used. The first supported profile is deliberately narrow: two copper layers, front-side SMD or through-hole footprints, circle/rectangle pads, one straight-line closed outline, and no existing tracks, vias, or zones. Konnect refuses unsupported geometry or custom DRC rules, or incomplete effective routing rules instead of approximating them, and writes a revision-bound reverse manifest beside the DSN for later SES import.","name":"export_specctra_dsn"},{"description":"Generate a component placement (pick-and-place) position file for SMT assembly. KiCad automatically omits footprints marked exclude_from_pos_files.","name":"export_position_file"},{"description":"Export the PCB to DXF using kicad-cli, one file per requested layer. Useful for mechanical CAD interchange (enclosures, panelization, laser cutting).","name":"export_dxf"},{"description":"Export the PCB in GenCAD format using kicad-cli. GenCAD is accepted by some CAM and test-fixture tooling as an alternative to a raw Gerber bundle.","name":"export_gencad"},{"description":"Export the PCB in IPC-2581 format using kicad-cli. IPC-2581 is a unified fabrication/assembly/test data format accepted by many contract manufacturers as an alternative to a Gerber + drill + BOM + pick-and-place bundle.","name":"export_ipc2581"},{"description":"Export the PCB in ODB++ format using kicad-cli. ODB++ is a unified fabrication data format accepted by many fab houses as an alternative to a Gerber + drill bundle.","name":"export_odb"},{"description":"Refill all copper pour zones on the board. KiCad IPC refills the complete board; per-zone selection is not available. Requires a running KiCad instance with IPC enabled.","name":"refill_zones"},{"description":"Run the Design Rule Check (DRC) on the PCB and return a list of violations. Provided in `pcb_export` because the output is handy to bundle alongside Gerbers when preparing a build package. For interactive / iterative DRC work, prefer `run_drc` (verification toolset) — same kicad-cli check, cleaner summary with error/warning counts.","name":"get_drc_violations"},{"description":"Create a new KiCAD project at the given path. Creates the directory, a blank .kicad_pro file, an empty .kicad_sch schematic, and a blank .kicad_pcb board file. Refuses to replace any existing project file.","name":"create_project"},{"description":"List PCB documents open in the running KiCad UI and optionally check whether one specific KiCad project or board is open over IPC.","name":"open_project"},{"description":"Save the currently open PCB board file via KiCAD IPC. Requires KiCAD to be running with IPC enabled.","name":"save_project"},{"description":"Rename a KiCAD project: renames the .kicad_pro/.kicad_sch/.kicad_pcb/.kicad_prl files and rewrites the internal references that carry the old name. Renaming the files alone is NOT enough — every symbol instance stores (project \"name\"), and a mismatch there makes KiCAD treat the design as unannotated, losing every reference designator. Equivalent to eeschema's File > Save As. Use dry_run first.","name":"rename_project"},{"description":"Read project metadata from a .kicad_pro file. Returns the project name, schematic and PCB paths, last modified time, project-file format version, and the generator versions recorded by the sibling design files. The compatibility kicad_version is null when those siblings disagree.","name":"get_project_info"},{"description":"Export the schematic and PCB to PDF as a timestamped snapshot/checkpoint. Useful for saving progress before major edits.","name":"snapshot_project"},{"description":"Launch the live schematic viewer. The viewer shows the schematic as SVG and auto-refreshes when the file changes. Use this after placing components so the user can see the schematic in real-time as you edit it. For hierarchical designs, pass the root schematic — the viewer discovers every sheet reachable from it and shows a sheet selector.","name":"open_schematic_viewer"}],"tools_added":21}
